title: Daily sales
description: Revenue and transactions per day for one country, from samples.bakehouse.sales_transactions and samples.bakehouse.sales_franchises.

args.query:
SELECT TO_DATE(t.dateTime) AS day, SUM(t.totalPrice) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS transactions
FROM samples.bakehouse.sales_transactions AS t
JOIN samples.bakehouse.sales_franchises AS f ON f.franchiseID = t.franchiseID
WHERE f.country = '{{country}}'
  AND t.dateTime >= '{{start_date}}'
GROUP BY TO_DATE(t.dateTime)
ORDER BY day;
